title: Redstone Hopper
description: Adds a Redstone Hopper, Redstone Hopper Minecart, and Item Filter for enhanced item sorting capabilities
body:
Adds 3 new items, a Redstone Hopper, Redstone Hopper Minecart, and an Item Filter.

![Redstone Hopper Mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a47cb40308ffab7f2c3ea4ace7ef36fecd031fc7_0.webp)

Right-Click with an Item Filter in your hand to open up the filter GUI, placing any number of items (maximum 27) inside it which will be filtered by the Redstone Hopper or Redstone Hopper Minecart.

Once the Item Filter is inside of either a Redstone Hopper or Redstone Hopper Minecart you can then select wether the filter is in Allow or Deny mode with the central button.

You can either place an Item Filter or any singular item inside of a Redstone Hopper or Redstone Hopper Minecart to enable the filtering.

The filter does NOT take into consideration enchantments, or custom NBT data. For example if you place a Diamond Sword in the Item Filter or directly into the Redstone Hopper, any/all Diamond Swords regardless of the enchantment will be filtered.

If nothing is placed into the Check slot then it acts as a normal hopper, any items can flow through it freely.
